name: qualia-connect
description: Work your real estate closings from a conversation: see which orders need attention, check an order's status, tasks and messages, read the documents your title company shared, message the people on the order, and place new title orders with a title company you work with. Messages and orders are shown to you in full and sent only after you confirm. Connects only to Qualia's Connect MCP server at connect.qualia.com.
